pool.text: A settlement was established in the region of Guadalajara by Cristóbal de Oñate.
Emperor Charles V granted a coat of arms and the title of city.
Guadalajara was officially founded in the Atemajac Valley on February 14.
The Metropolitan Cathedral was consecrated after construction began decades prior.
The Palace of the State Government was finished in architectural styles.
Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla established Mexico's first revolutionary government in Guadalajara.
The Cristero War ended within the confines of the city.
Funding was restated for the concerts in Guadalajara after catching authorities' attention.
The first industrial park was established during the period of urban growth.
An organization called Conciertos Guadalajara A was formed in the city.
The municipal palace was constructed across the street from the monument.
The Jalisco Famous People Roundabout monument was built using quarried stone.
The population of the city surpassed the one million milestone.
The traditional festivals of October have been held since this year.
The Guadalajara International Airport opened to serve the region.
The orchestra became affiliated with the Department of Fine Arts of Jalisco.
An important convention center was built in Mexico.
The Festival Cultural de Mayo began as an annual recurring event.
The current name was adopted by the organization in Guadalajara.
Gasoline explosions in the sewer system destroyed streets in Analco.
